lane: datum-offset: Lake Lahontan shorelines as a strain gauge (the assigned lane)
hypothesis: A fault that crosses the near-level Lahontan shoreline datum steps that datum, and the step trace CROSSES the datum contours -- unlike basin level features (bluffs, berms, fan-head risers, delta topsets), which run contour-parallel. A contour-crossing step in the datum residual is therefore a fault candidate of a class that lineament-based catalogues under-represent.
mechanism: stands (local tile mode, 8 km tiles, band 1157-1455 m) -> robust quadratic isobase (Huber IRLS, 6 terms) -> r = z - isobase -> Frangi ridge of |grad r| -> offset |r(+250 m)-r(-250 m)| -> gates (evidence>=0.10, step>=2 m, <=1500 m from bench, cross-cut>=30 deg, 2 km suppression) -> 5-candidate heading traces while DEM evidence>=0.15 -> dotted emission
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Wave-cut bluffs, beach berms, fan-head risers and delta topsets are level steps in the same elevation band -- the flat-pixel histogram contains 15 separate stands between 1175 and 1437 m. Aeolian/playa-margin steps and basin-floor terracing are the same family.

holdout.ci_note: fold-wise CI not estimable: 5 of 6 folds contain no predictions; the Wilson interval is on the pooled kernel-weighted recall

holdout.dti_ci_note: A 95% CI for pooled DTI is not estimable from this six-fold run: five folds have no predictions. The stored Wilson interval is for pooled kernel-weighted recall, not DTI.
